answer: Reaching eligibility takes 87 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The zephyr register is checked at draw time, orchard lists the eligible set, and walnut seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 87 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Each impostor pays 18 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
